The Site parameter now accepts multiple selections. It's set to multi-value, so people will see a multi-select list when they run the report.

One thing to know before you rely on it: nothing in the report uses the Site parameter yet. The DAX query in DataSet1 has no site filter, and no textbox or tablix references `Parameters!Site`. So choosing several sites will not change the rows shown in FleetTable until the query filters on them. I didn't make that change because it means rewriting the DAX, which you didn't ask for. If you want it, I can add a filter on `'Assets'[Site]` that uses the selected values.

The validation pass shows no new errors. The warnings it lists were already there: two unused data sources (LegacySQL and ScratchPowerQuery), DateFrom and DateTo typed as String, and a Utilization field that the query doesn't return.
